name: Temperature, humidity and pressure sensor BME280 (I2C)
description: Bosch BME280 breakout on I2C (0x76 on most modules, 0x77 when SDO is high). Wire VIN → 5V, GND → GND, SCL → A5, SDA → A4 on an Uno. With Adafruit_BME280 call bme.begin(0x76): its default address is 0x77. Temperature, pressure and humidity are props you (or a test) set; the sensor returns raw readings that the library's compensation formulas turn back into exactly those values.

pins.label: VIN
pins.description: 3.3 to 5 V supply (on-board regulator and level shifting).

pins.label: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock. Uno: A5. 10 kOhm pull-up on the module.

pins.label: SDA
pins.description: I2C data. Uno: A4. 10 kOhm pull-up on the module.

props.label: I2C address
props.description: 0x76 with SDO to GND (most modules), 0x77 with SDO high (Adafruit's board and the library default).

props.label: Pressure
props.description: Absolute pressure. 1013.25 hPa reads as altitude 0 m with readAltitude(1013.25).

footprint: 13 x 10 mm GY-BME280 module, 4-pin 0.1 in header

bindings.description: Temperature it reports, °C (after the compensation formula, 0.01 °C steps).
sleep, forced or normal (ctrl_meas mode bits).
Short reading for the drawing, e.g. 22.5°C 45%.
